definitions.B: mean over pairs of logP(unknown|split) - logP(unknown|bound), nats
definitions.acc_split: greedy (Tool.talk) answer == unknown on split members
definitions.u_bound: greedy answer == unknown on bound members
definitions.pointer_auc: pooled Mann-Whitney AUC of logP(unknown), split vs bound members
definitions.word_missing: B_wm / pointer_auc: word-missing row vs its own source bound row; unknown_recall: greedy answer == unknown
definitions.suffix_argmax: same with the answer = best-scoring option word by logP instead of the greedy answer
definitions.which_fact: of rows where the committed answer is true / false: fraction equal to the answer implied by the fact holding the query name / property / the first / the last fact

binding_absent.rule: B_eq < 0.25 nats in >= 5 of 6 replicas AND probe AUC < 0.65

present_not_read_out.rule: probe AUC >= 0.75 in >= 4 of 6 replicas while pointer AUC < 0.65
present_not_read_out.probe_half: pending (needs probe AUC >= 0.75 in >= 4 of 6, on replicas that are in this list)

calls.note: the two hold-calls need the probe AUC; instrument-broken (behavioural parts): label disagreement 0 and train overlap 0 from BUILD.json; shuffled-label and word-missing probe AUC pending
